rationale: This mutation resolves the -$18.3k cash deficit by implementing continuous capital-velocity liquidations (at 30% shed or 6+ units) to abolish inventory hoarding, while explicitly preserving Town Shop arbitrage by procuring Pumpkins and Tomatoes strictly for active contracts. It transitions all remaining acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries for multi-harvest compounding, gates land expansion to 12-14 plots before Day 16 to prevent overextension, and mandates cluster harvesting with priority watering to reclaim wasted transit steps.
